CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doc"."workflow_monitoring" (
   "monitor_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
   "kind" TEXT,
   "pipeline" TEXT,
   "payload" TEXT INDEX OFF STORAGE WITH (
      columnstore = false
   ),
   "updated_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
   "lease_token" TEXT,
   "lease_expires_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
   PRIMARY KEY ("monitor_key")
)
CLUSTERED BY ("monitor_key") INTO 1 SHARDS
WITH (
   column_policy = 'strict',
   number_of_replicas = '1'
)
